scope: Identity discrimination of the queue-token and hold-piece heads on the four published frozen M3 error runs, read from saved per-case diagnostics and the frozen exposure audit's labels only. Constant-predictor consistency is computed from published error indices, so it reports what the saved bytes prove and no per-slot predicted token class. No inference, training, mask, target, order or loss change, and no complete-state, real-image or release claim.
